{{Top|leg}}
A '''rappel line''' was a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] device that was used by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] was among the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to carry such a device.
